spans.s:
COMB (subs.):
I For hair:
(1) प्रसाधनी;
(2)
कङ्कतिका।
II For carding wool: *मार्जनी (?).
III Of a cock: चूडा।
IV Honeycomb:
q. v. V. A valley: q. v.
COMB (v. t.): सम्मार्जयति (मृज्, c. 10): v. To dress.

COMBAT (subs.): v. Battle, contest. Ph.:
single-c.
द्वन्द्वयुद्धम्,
close c.:
नियुद्धम्।
COMBAT (v. i.): v. To contend, struggle.

COMBAT (v. t.):
I To fight with: q. v.
II
To oppose, resist: q. v.

COMBATANT:
I Lit: योद्धृ (f. द्ध्री).
II Fig.:
विरोधिन् (f. नी).
COMBATIVE: युयुत्सु (mfn.).

COMBINATION:
(1) संहतिः,
to break their c.:
तत्सं-
संहतिभेदाय, Mu. II.; c. even of little things:
अल्पानामपि वस्तूनां संहतिः, H.;
(2) समवायः,
much
more their c.:
किमुतसमवायः, K.: v. Union.
Ph.:
c. of letters:
सन्धिः, c. (in algebra)
*समवायः।

COMBINE (v.):
I Trans.: v. To join, unite.
II Intrans.: expr. by the parts: संहतः
(ता, तं), समवेतः (ता, तं),
or
मिलितः (ता, तं),
they c. d together to invade it:
इतमभियोक्तुं मिलिता
 बभुबुः।

COMBUSTIBLE:
(1) दाह्यः (ह्या, ह्यं);
(2) दहनीयः
(या, यं). Any c. material:
(1) दाह्यम्
or
दाह्य-
पदार्थः;
(2) इन्धनम्, R. xiii. 4.

COME:
(1) आगच्छति (गम्, c. l), I am c. ing:
अयमागतोऽस्मि, Mr. ix.; does not c. (back) yet:
नाद्याप्यगच्छति, Mr. v.;
will he c. here:
किमय-
मत्रागमिष्यति, K.;
(2) एति (इ, c. 2),
c. c. my
child:
एह्येहि वत्स, Vi. i.;
(3) आयाति (या, c.
2),
came to Yudhishthira:
युधिष्ठिरं समाययौ, Ki. []
i. 1. Ph.:
the summer season is c.:
निदाधकालोऽ-
यमुपागतः, Ri. i. l.;
the news of his father's
death is c.:
तस्य पितृमरणवार्ता समागता। N. B. These
verbs take an acc.
COME ABOUT: v. Pass, come to.

COME AFTER:
I To go after, follow: q. v.:
अनुगच्छति (गम्, c. l).
II To come for: Ph.:
he came after a book:
*स पुस्तकार्थमाजगाम।

COME AGAIN: प्रत्यागच्छति (गम्, c. l): v. To
come back, return.

COME ALONG:
(1) आगच्छति;
(2) एति: v. To
come.

COME AT: अधिगच्छति (गम्, c. l): v. To reach,
attain.

COME AWAY:
I To depart: q. v.
II To
come off: q. v.
COME BY: i. e. to gain, obtain, acquire: q. v.

COME DOWN:
I To get down, descend: q. v.
अवतरति (तॄ, c. l).
II To be handed down:
Ph. the writings of Kālidāsa have c. to us:
कालिदासकृतप्रबन्धा अस्मत्सकाशमागताः।

COME FORTH: निर्गच्छति (गम्, c. l): v. To
come out.

COME IN:
I To enter: q. v.: प्रविशति (विश्,
c. 6):
II To comply: q. v.
III To become
fashionable: v. Fashionable.

COME IN FOR: Ph.: they did not c. in for a share:
*अंशग्रहणाय नाजग्मुः।

COME INTO: v. To agree, comply. Ph.:
c.
into vogue:
प्रचलितः (ता, तं) भवति (भू, c. l);
then they will c. into my power:
वशमेष्यन्ति मे
 तदा, H. i.

COME NEAR:
I Lit.: उपसर्पति (सृप्, c. l): v.
To approach.
II Fig.: Ph.:
nothing anci-
ent or modern c. s near this achievement
*एतादृशं
 कर्म कदापि न सम्पन्नम्।
COME OF: i. e. to issue or produce from: q. v.

COME OFF:
I To come out of: निष्पतति (पत्,
c. l),
fire came off his eye:
अक्ष्णः कृशानुः किल
 निष्पपात, Ku.:
II To be carried through:
निर्गच्छति।
III To take place: q. v.: आपतति।

COME OUT:
I Lit.: निर्गच्छति;
(2) निष्क्रामति:
v. To go out.
II Of the teeth etc.:
(1)
उद्गच्छति, निर्-, (गम्, c. l);
(2) उदेति (इ, c.
2);
(3) उद्भिनत्ति (भिद्, c. 7),
as no beard
had c. out
अनुभ्दिन्नश्मश्रुराजितया, K. iii. To be
published: निर्गच्छति
or
बहिर्गच्छति: v. To
publish.

spans.s:
COME OVER:
I To pass over: Ph.:
if they get
an assailant like you, they will leave him and c.
over to you:
त्वदृशमभियोक्तारमासाद्यै नं परित्यज्य त्वामे-
वाश्रयन्ते, Mu. iv.
II Of feelings, etc. Ph.:
a sudden chill came over him
*सहसा तस्य गात्रं
 शीतं बभूव।

COME ROUND: Ph.:
he will c. round to our
opinion:
स स्वमतं परित्यज्यास्माकं मतं ग्रहीष्यति or
मतावलम्बनं करिष्यति।

COME SHORT: न्यूनीभवति (भू, c. l): v. To
Fall short.

COME TO:
I Lit.: v. To come. N. B. With
respect to persons सकाशं should be used:
I have c. to you here:
त्वत्सकाशमिहागतः, M. p.
Ph.:
c. to memory
स्मृतिभागच्छति, A. r.;
c. to
one's ears:
श्रुतिपथमायाति, Sa., श्रुतिमागच्छति, N.;
c. to pieces:
खण्डखण्डं भवति, let it never c. to pass:
मास्मभूत्, Ki.;
c. to one's self:
संज्ञां लभते (लभ्, c.
l) v. To recover;
c. to life:
उज्जीवति (जीव्,
l);
c. to an end:
अवसानं गच्छतिः v. To end;
c. to an agreement: v. To agree.
II To
arrive at: q. v.
III: To amount to: q. v.

COME UP:
I Lit.: आपतति, प्रा-, सन्नि-, (पत्, c. l),
saw Keyuraka c. -ing up:
आपतन्तं केयूरकमद्राक्षीत्,
K.
II To spring, come out: q. v.: निर्गच्छति।

COME UP TO:
I To arrive at:
(1) समुपगच्छति;
(2) समागच्छति;
(3) समायाति:
(4) समुपसर्पति
(सृप्, c. l).
II Fig.: to equal: q. v.
COME UP WITH: v. To overtake.
COME UPON: आक्रामति (क्रम्, c. l): v. To attach.

COMEDIAN:
I An actor: q. v.: नटः।
II A
writer: *हर्षप्रधाननाटकलेखकः,
or
रचयितृ (m.) or
-कृत,
COMEDY: *हर्षप्रधाननाटकं (or less precisely) नाटकम्।

COMELINESS: v. Suitableness, symmetry, gra-
-cefulness.

COMELY:
I Becoming: q. v.
II Beautiful,
handsome: q. v.: सुदर्शनः (ना, नं).

COMETARY:
(1) by comp. with धमकेतु-;
(2)
by gen. of धूमकेतु।
COMFIT: v. Sweetmeat.

COMFORT (v. t.): आश्वासयति (c. of श्वस्): v.
Console, cheer.

COMFORT (subs.):
I Consolation, solace:
q. v.: आश्वासः।
II Pleasure: सुखम्,
enjoying
every c.
सर्वसुखान्यनुमवन्तः, K.

COMFORTABLE:
are you c. here:
अप्यत्र भवत्याः
 सुखम्? V. p.: v. Pleasant.

COMFORTABLY: सुख-, in comp.,
sleeping c.:
सुखसुप्तः
(प्ता, प्तं), Mah.: v. Pleasantly, conveniently.

COMFORTER: आश्वासकः or expr. by verb: v.
To console.
COMFORTLESS; v. Uncomfortable.

COMIC, COMICAL:
I Diverting, sportive:
q. v.:
(1) हासकरः (री, रं);
(2) हासजननः (नी,
 नं).
II Relating to a comedy:
is this
drama c.
*अपि नाटकमिदं हर्षप्रधानम्।

COMING:
I Subs: आगमः, -नं।
II Adj.: आगा-
मिन् (f. नी).
COMMA: *कमा; पदविच्छेदकचिह्नविशेषः।

COMMAND (v. t.):
I To give a c.:
(1) आज्ञा-
पयति, सं-, (c. of ज्ञा) (with two acc.), c. (me)
what you have to be done:
आज्ञापय यत्ते करणीय-
मस्ति, Ku. iii. 3;
(2) आ-दिशति, नि-, (दिश्,
c. 6): v. To order.
II To be in c. of:
(1) अधितिष्ठति (स्था, c. l),
the forces c. ed by my
father:
ताताधिष्ठितानां बलानाम्, Ve. iii.;
(2) अध्यास्ते
(आस्, c. 2),
Virūpākṣa wanted to c. the
heart of the city:
विरूपाक्षः पुरोदरमव्यासिसिषांचक्रे,
B. xiv. 16.
III To govern, control: q. v.
IV Of position; expr. by circum,
the house
c. s a beautiful view of the lake:
*अस्माद्गृहात्सरः
 सुन्दरमवलोकयिन्तुं शक्यते।

COMMAND (subs.):
I Order:
(1) आज्ञा,
at
Rāma's c.
रामाज्ञया, R.;
(2) आदेश:
or
निदेशः,
receiving their master's c.:
भर्तुरादेशं समवाप्य, Ki.
vi. 43,;
(3) शासनम् (a stronger term),
who
would transgress your majesty's c.:
कोदेवस्य शासन-
मुल्लङ्घयिष्यति, Mu. iii.;
(4) नियोगः (=direc-
-tion),
by his father's c.:
पितुर्नियोगात्, R. xiv.
43.
II The power to c.: expr. by circum.,
putting himself in c. of his treasury and army:
तत्कोषवाहनमात्माधिष्ठितं कृत्वा, D. viii.: v. To
command (II); appoint (him)
to the c. of the
army:
अभिषिच्यतां सैनापत्ये, Ve.
III Control,
government: q. v.
COMMANDANT: v. Commander.

COMMANDER:
I Lit.:
(1) आज्ञापकः, c. of all kings:
सर्वभूतलभुजामाज्ञापकः, Mu. ii.;
(2) आदेष्ट्ट (m.).
II
Of an army:
(1) सेनानीः;
(2) सेनापतिः;
(3)
सेनाध्यक्षः
III Of a vessel: पोताध्यक्षः; पोतनायकः;
and im. comp. s. Ph.:
c. -in-chief:
महासनापतिः
(used in ancient grants): v. Generalissimo.

COMMEMORATE: कीर्तयति, सं-, (कीर्त्, c. 10) (?):
v. To celebrate.
COMMEMORATION: संकीर्तनम् (?): v. Celebration.
COMMEMORATIVE: स्मारकः (की, कं) (?).

COMMENCE:
(1) आरभते (रभ्, c. l);
(2) प्रक्रमते
(क्रम्, c. l): v. To begin.

COMMENCEMENT:
(1) आरम्भः;
(2) प्रारम्भः: v.
Beginning.

COMMEND (v. t.):
I To entrust, deliver: q. v.:
अर्पयति (c. of ॠ).
II To praise: q. v.: प्रशंसति
(शंस्, c. l).
III To recommend: q. v.
IV To
present as worthy of regard: expr. by अभि-
मतः (ता, तं) or circum.,
what you say does not
c. to me:
त्वद्वचो नामिनन्दामि, Sa.

COMMENDABLE: शलाध्यः (ध्था, घ्यं): v. Praise-
-worthy.
COMMENDABLY: v. Laudably.

COMMENDATION:
I Approbation, praise:
q. v.
II Recommendation: q. v.
III Com-
-pliments: q. v.

COMMENDATORY:
I Subs.: v. Praise.
II Adj.:
expr. by comp. Ph.:
this is c.:
अर्थवाद एषः, U.
COMMENSURABLE: सजातीयः (या, यं) (?).

COMMENSURATE:
I Lit.: सजातीयः (या, यं) (?).
II Proportional: q. v.

COMMENT (v.):
I To annotate: q. v.
II
To make remarks: अनुयुनक्ति (युज्, c. l) (?):
v. Remark.

COMMENT (subs.):
I In pl., observations,
remarks: q. v.
II Annotation, explana-
-tion: q. v.

COMMENTARY:
I Lit.:
(1) व्याख्या;
(2) वृत्तिः,
c. on Manu:
मनुवृत्तिः, K. b.;
(3) टीका,
Rāmā-
yaṇa with its c.:
सटीकं रामायणम्;
(4) भाष्यम् (=c.
on aphorisms).
II Criticism: q. v. Ph.:
c. s.
of Caesar.:
*किंशूरव्याख्यानम्।

COMMENTITIOUS: काल्पनिकः (की, कं): V. Ficti-
-tious.

COMMERCE:
I Trade, traffic: वाणिज्यम्।
II
Intercourse: q. v.

COMMERCIAL:
(1) comp. with वाणिज्य-;
(2)
वाणिज्यविषयकः (का, कं).
C.-treaty
*वाणिज्य-
द्रव्याणामागमनिर्गमविषयकः सन्धिः; a c. nation
*वाणिज्यपरायणा जातिः।
COMMINATION: तर्जनम्ः v. Threat, menace.

COMMINGLE: मिश्रयति, सं-, (मिश्र्, c. 10.): v.
To mingle.

COMMINUTE: चूर्णयति (चूर्ण्, c. 10.): v. To
pulverize, grind.
COMMISERATE: दयते (दय्, c. l.): v. To pity.

COMMISSARIAT:
I The department: *वीवध-
दानविभागः
II Commissaryship: अधिकारः (?)

COMMISSARY: अधिकृतः (?),
c. of horse:
*अश्वाधि-
कृतः।

COMMISSION (subs.):
I Perpetration: q. v.:
Ph.:
c. of sin:
पापाचरणम्, K. b.;
was caught in
the c. of theft:
चौर्यं कुर्वन् गृहीतः।
II Entrusting:
अर्पणम्, सम्-।
III The business entrusted:
नियोगः,
attend to your c.:
स्वं नियोगमशून्यं कुरु, Sa.
IV A number of persons joined in an
office or trust: *परीक्षकाः (m. pl.). V. Allow-
-ance for transacting business: no equiv.:
expr. by circum.
VI In the army: पदम् (?).

COMMISSION (v.): नियुंक्ते (युज्, c. 7.): v. To
charge, empower.

COMMISSIONER:
I In gen. sense: अधिकृतः, a
careless c.:
अधिकृतः प्रमादी, H.
II Of a divi
sion: प्रदेशपालः।

COMMIT (v. t.):
I To entrust: q. v.: अर्पयति,
सम्-, (c. of ॠ), c. these (prisoners) to his
care:
तस्मै समर्पयैतान्, P. Ph.: was c. ted to
prison:
बन्धनमनीयत, D. ii.; to c. to the
sessions:
*अधिवेशनविचारार्थम् अर्पयति; to c. to
memory:
कण्ठस्थं करोति; c. (this) to writing :
अभिलिख्यताम्, Mr. ix.
II To perpetrate :
करोति (कृ, c. 8.),
to c. crimes wilfully:
कामतः
पापानि करोति M.; one who c. s an offence :
अपराधिन् (f. नी).
III To match: q. v.

COMMITMENT: To the sessions: *अधिवेशन-
 विचारार्पणम्। For other senses: v. To commit.
COMMITTEE: सभा।
COMMODIOUS: v. Convenient, comfortable.

COMMODIOUSLY: v. Conveniently, comfort
ably.

COMMODIOUSNESS:
I Convenience: q. v.
II.
Spaciousness: q. v.

COMMODITY: पण्यम्, import and export of c. s
पण्यानामागमनिर्गमौ, M.

COMMON (adj.):
I Belonging to more than
one:
(1) साधारणः (णी णं), c. property
साधारणधनम्, Da.;
c. to many:
बहुसाधारण
(णी, णं), Da.;
(2) सामान्यः (न्या, न्यं), thi
(gem)
is c. to me and Balabhadra:
एतन्म।
 बलभद्रस्य च सामान्यम्, V. p.
II Usual, ordinary
(1) साधारणः (णी णं),
c. council:
साधारणसभा
c. crier:
*साधारणघोषकः;
c. noun:
*साधारणनाम
(n.);
(2) सामान्यः (न्या, न्यं), “c. dame”
सामान्यनायिका, Sah.;
c. weaver:
साभान्यकौलिक
P. ii. 5.;
c. word:
सामान्यशब्दः, N. d,; a c.
man:
सामान्यजनः, Ra. v. (इतरः, V. p.). Ph.
c. saying:
जनप्रवादः, N.;
c. gender:
स्त्रीपुंलिङ्गम्
c. law:
देशाचारः;
the c. people:
लौकिकाः, T.
or
प्रकृतयः, R.;
c. sense:
विवेकः।

COMMON; IN:
(1) सामान्येन
or
सामान्यतः,
but the
three gems were held in c.:
किन्तु रत्नत्रयं साभान्ये
 स्थितभ्, Vet.;
(2) साधारण्येन, in c. with others
*अन्येषां साधारण्येन।
COMMON (subs.): साधारणप्रचारभूमिः, V. p. com.

COMMONPLACE:
I Adj.: सामान्यः (न्या, न्यं).
C.
book:
*सामान्यसन्निवेशः।
II Subs.: साधारणप्रवादः।
COMMONAGE: साधारणभूमौ प्रचाराधिकारः।
COMMONALTY: v. Commons. (I)

COMMONS:
I The mass of the people:
(1)
प्रजाः (f. pl.);
(2) प्रकृतयः (f. pl.);
(3)
लोकाः (m. pl.).
The House of C.:
*प्रजासभा।
A member of the H. of C.:
*प्रजासभासदस्यः or
प्रजासभास्थः।
